name: Hand of the old ones
source:
A silly visual novel where you summon an eldritch deity, but things go wrong. You need to help him get back to his full power.

[From [url=https://sheepy-azi.itch.io/hand-of-the-old-ones]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部无厘头视觉小说：你召唤出一位诡异的神祇，事情却出了岔子。你得帮助祂恢复全部力量。

[摘自[url=https://sheepy-azi.itch.io/hand-of-the-old-ones]itch.io[/url]]
